prompts.RapidCartoon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D game sprite. Input image is the user's ORIGINAL project-generated cartoon style reference, not a collage target. Create ONLY the RAPID wooden watchtower from upper left of reference, very faithfully matching proportions, thick black ink outlines, warm golden wooden beams, cross braces, dark iron straps and rivets, four pale gray stone footings, red tiled flaring roof, little gold cap, small arrow slit. Same elevated three-quarter view as the reference. Hand-painted cartoon 2D illustration, crisp broad shading, absolutely no pixel art, no photorealism. One whole tower centered, all footings and roof visible with 8% clear margin, feet near bottom. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no terrain patch, no cast shadow extending outside tower. Preserve silhouette and viewpoint exactly, do not turn the footing into a flattened diamond. This is a single standalone game sprite, NOT a concept sheet.
prompts.LongshotFire: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game animation SPRITE SHEET. Input image is the project's original cartoon style reference. Recreate ONLY the LONGSHOT stone-based spoon catapult from the reference in matching hand-painted cartoon 2D, crisp dark outlines, golden wood, gray square stone enclosure, black iron straps, red front banner without any white emblem, spoon cup holding round gray rock. Output exactly 1536x1024, a strict 6 COLUMN by 4 ROW equal-cell grid, each cell 256x256, transparent background, NO lines or text. 24 full catapult sprites, each with exactly the SAME scale and stationary stone foundation at the SAME cell location; feet at y=232 from cell top, top never above y=16; left/right safety margin 16 pixels. The STONE FOUNDATION always has the same three-quarter view and never moves. Only the inner wooden mechanism turns. Row 1 inner catapult aims screen upper RIGHT (reference facing); row 2 aims upper LEFT; row 3 aims lower LEFT; row 4 aims lower RIGHT. Within each row six successive firing poses: column1 idle loaded spoon raised; column2 draw spoon back with rock; column3 release spoon swings forward with rock just leaving cup; column4 empty cup fully forward; column5 empty cup returns halfway; column6 idle loaded again, identical to column1. No floating projectile in empty cup frames4/5. Maintain exact outer foundation geometry, same banner location, same camera and lighting across ALL24 cells, no squash/stretch. Solid wide clear forms readable at 100px. No skeletons, no other buildings, no scenery, no checkerboard, no baked floor shadow, no labels. All cells contain the COMPLETE CATAPULT, never parts.
prompts.CartoonGrass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square 2D game GROUND ALBEDO tile, opaque. Input image is project's original cartoon reference. Match the GREEN TURF in its bottom gameplay strip. Fill entire square with dense inviting medium olive and fresh spring green cartoon turf, broad clustered short leaf shapes, deep leafy green pockets with small soft lighter green highlights, scattered small hand-painted blade clusters. Visually quiet enough beneath towers; larger clean readable shapes rather than speckled noise. Hand-painted 2D cartoon, clean restrained dark-green ink contours. TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP DOWN with no perspective, no visible horizon, no objects casting long shadows. Seamlessly repeat all four edges, consistent brightness throughout, no vignette, no central feature. No yellow soil, no fluorescent lime/yellow grain, no flowers, no bushes, no stones, no buildings, no paths, no borders, no words. This is a flat texture map to wrap on an existing 3D ground plane; do not draw an isometric grass square or a scene.
prompts.CartoonPaving: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square 2D game GROUND ALBEDO tile, opaque. Input image is project's original cartoon reference. Faithfully match the STONE PAVING of its bottom gameplay strip. Entire tile is irregular rounded rectangular large gray stone slabs laid in lightly staggered courses, warm and cool gray variation, narrow dark earthy joints, subtly chipped edges, thin controlled ink contour on edges, broad soft hand-painted face shading, occasional tiny moss flecks in joints. Approximately 7 slabs across tile, and 8 courses vertically. Stones mostly flat, little surface noise, no rocky gravel. TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP DOWN, zero isometric perspective or diamond grid: horizontal and vertical slab edges aligned to image axes. Seamlessly repeat every edge. Even diffuse lighting from upper left, no large shadows. No grass areas, no ground border, no terrain patch, no flowers, no ruins, no walls, no towers, no labels. No photographic texture, no pixel art, no cracked mud. This is a flat albedo texture to wrap onto existing ground geometry.
